title: Content Trust v1 - Honest Quality Assessment
summary: QUESTION BANK IS 2.7% TRUSTWORTHY. Metadata completeness does NOT equal content correctness.
repair_plan: P0 - Gate: Block all Q-tier questions from student-facing flows. Only serve the ~173 trusted questions now.
P0 - Dedupe: Remove the 100 duplicate aptitude/logical/verbal questions; keep 1 representative each and author genuine replacements (28 required).
P1 - High-value placement: Repair questions tagged TCS/Infosys/Wipro/Cognizant/Accenture/Amazon/Google/Microsoft first, authoring correct solutions + test cases + verified answers.
P1 - Fix test cases: For coding questions where code runs, regenerate expected outputs by executing the (corrected) solution rather than trusting stored expected values.
P2 - Foundational: Repair arrays/strings/hashing/trees/graphs/DP etc. with verified solutions.
P2 - Author missing: Write real solutions for the 3,217 template/no-answer questions.
P3 - Depth: Build Concept→Guided→Practice→Pattern→Timed→Placement→OA→Interview progressions for every key skill.
P3 - Provenance: Only claim company relevance where verified; otherwise label 'pattern-relevant to X'.
Every repaired question must pass: code executes, all test cases match, explanation agrees, complexity stated matches actual, title matches problem.

duplicate_families.aptitude_50_questions_identical_discount: All 50 aptitude questions share the exact same '20% and 10% discount' prompt and '28%' answer, only topic label differs (Percentages, Profit&Loss, Time&Work, etc.).
duplicate_families.logical_30_questions_identical_series_pr: All 30 logical questions share the exact same '1, 3, 6, 10, ?' prompt and '15' answer, only topic label differs (Series, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, etc.).
duplicate_families.verbal_20_questions_identical_ubiquitous: All 20 verbal questions share the exact same 'Synonym of Ubiquitous' prompt and 'Present everywhere' answer, only topic label differs (Synonyms, Antonyms, Spelling, Grammar, etc.).

root_causes: Bulk coding questions have solutions that do not match their own test-case expected outputs (only ~13% consistency).
Auto-extracted answers (68% match code output) are internally consistent with code but NOT with the test cases students will see.
Aptitude/logical/verbal are template duplicates masquerading as distinct questions - severe duplicate + provenance failure.
3,217 coding questions have no answer or template-only solutions and were never actually authored.
Original q_ questions (131) have sensible manual answers but zero test cases, so correctness cannot be programmatically verified.
